tagline: Your personal database, close at hand.
emptyLibrariesHint: Bring your notes, ideas or projects together.
emptyCollectionHint: Add your first entry. It will be saved on this device.
chooseCollectionHint: Create a collection in your library and add your first entry.
entriesUnavailableHint: The list could not be loaded. Please try again.

errors.nativeRequired: Open Tessera in the desktop or Android app to access native storage.
errors.sqliteUnsupported: This SQLite build lacks required features. The database was not changed.
errors.unsupportedSchema: Unsupported database version or structure. The database is preserved unchanged. Open it in a compatible Tessera build and export your data before switching. Keep the original database: full Database Export is not yet implemented in this dev build.
errors.databaseCorrupt: Database integrity check failed. Preserve the database files for recovery.
errors.invalidName: Enter a name between 1 and 200 characters.
errors.notFound: The object was not found or was deleted.
errors.unsupportedField: This field type is not supported yet.
errors.generic: The action failed. Your form is still on screen. Try again.
errors.invalidInteger: Enter an integer in the JavaScript safe range.
errors.outOfRange: Value is outside the allowed range.
errors.invalidPosition: Order must be a non-negative integer.
errors.invalidPrimaryField: Choose a text field in this collection.
errors.fieldTypeChange: An existing field type cannot be changed.
errors.protectedField: Choose a different primary or incoming field first.
errors.purgedRecord: This record has been purged and cannot be restored.
errors.primaryMustBeVisible: The primary field must remain visible in the form.
errors.hiddenRequiredField: A hidden required field needs a default value.
errors.invalidFilter: Check the field, operator and filter value.
errors.invalidCursor: The query changed. Reload the list.
errors.searchUpdating: The search index is updating. Retry when it finishes.
errors.invalidCsv: Invalid CSV. Check quotes and delimiters.
errors.csvColumns: Column count does not match the header.
errors.csvTooLarge: File exceeds 100 MB. Split it into smaller CSV files.
errors.fileError: Could not write the file. Check permissions and free space.
errors.fileBusy: Complete the current file operation first.
errors.invalidSearch: Search allows at most 200 characters and 12 words.
errors.invalidRelation: Check UUIDs, target collection and cardinality. Duplicates are not allowed.
errors.readOnlyField: A backlink is derived from forward relations and cannot be entered.
errors.crossLibraryRelation: Relations must stay within one library.
errors.relationDefinitionChange: Changing an existing target or cardinality requires conversion. Create a new field.
errors.relationTargetMismatch: The record does not belong to this relation target collection.
errors.relationUnavailable: The new target is unavailable or deleted. Existing links are retained.
errors.relationsUpdating: The relation index is updating. Retry when it finishes.
errors.systemContainer: This system container cannot be changed or deleted.
errors.invalidInboxMove: Only an Inbox entry can be moved to a regular collection.
errors.staleRecord: This entry changed after the form was opened. Your input remains on screen.
errors.invalidDraft: The local draft is damaged or has an unsupported format. It has not replaced database contents.
errors.draftWrite: The local draft could not be saved or removed. Your input remains in the form; check available storage and retry.
errors.draftCleanup: The entry was saved, but its local draft could not be removed. Do not delete application data.
errors.lastProfile: The last display profile cannot be deleted.
errors.invalidPreset: This preset is unavailable or incompatible with the current fields. Review its settings; no record was created.
errors.invalidInboxMapping: Inbox text cannot be mapped to these collection fields. Choose available text fields.
errors.invalidUrl: Enter a full HTTP/HTTPS URL without credentials.
errors.externalOpenFailed: The external application could not open this link.
errors.operationCancelled: Operation cancelled. The database was not changed.
errors.invalidCsvEncoding: The file could not be decoded. Choose the correct encoding.
errors.invalidLibraryNavigation: Choose a collection and profile from this library.
errors.shortcutUnavailable: Could not request a shortcut. Check whether your launcher supports pinned shortcuts.
errors.draftRecovery: Could not preserve a separate copy of the damaged draft. The original file remains; check storage and retry creating the record.
errors.recordNotDeleted: Move the record to Trash first.
errors.invalidAttachment: This attachment does not fit the field or belongs to another record. Select the file again.
errors.attachmentMissing: Attachment metadata is unavailable. The original value is preserved.
errors.fileMissing: The local file copy is missing. You can select the original file and verify its hash.
errors.fileCorrupt: The file size or SHA-256 does not match the saved metadata. The copy was not used.
errors.fileExists: A local copy already exists. Verify it first; a corrupt copy can be explicitly removed.
errors.lastAttachmentCopy: This is the only known copy. Explicit confirmation is required to remove it.
errors.invalidFileChunk: The file chunk could not be copied. Retry the operation.
errors.invalidFileOffset: The file copy offset is invalid. Retry the operation.
errors.invalidAttachmentLimit: Enter a valid nonnegative attachment size.
errors.previewUnavailable: Preview supports small raster images. Export a copy to view this file.
errors.attachmentCleanup: Some files could not be removed. Their removal remains queued for a safe retry.
errors.attachmentMultiplicity: Changing an existing file field’s multiplicity requires conversion. Create another field.
errors.csvAttachment: CSV does not transfer attachment bytes. File columns can be exported, but attachment import requires a database archive.
errors.notEnoughSpace: Not enough free space to import.
errors.archiveRowTooLarge: Record exceeds the archive format limit.
errors.importRecoveryFailed: Recovery could not complete. Original files are preserved; keep the application data directory.
errors.archiveMissingFiles: The archive contains placeholders for missing small files whose bytes are unavailable on this device.
errors.invalidDecimal: Enter a decimal number. Up to five decimal places are saved.
errors.decimalOverflow: The value exceeds the exact range: ±92,233,720,368,547.75807. Store very long codes in text fields.
errors.invalidChoice: Check choices and their stable identifiers.
errors.invalidTime: Enter a valid literal local time without a time zone.
errors.invalidDateRange: Enter both dates; the end cannot precede the start.
errors.invalidCoordinates: Latitude must be between −90 and 90; longitude between −180 and 180.
errors.invalidSecret: Secrets cannot be used in general lists, indexes or defaults.
errors.invalidWidget: Check the input control and positive step.
errors.invalidFormula: Enter a formula and choose its result type. Calculated fields are read-only.
errors.formulaSyntax: Check formula parentheses, operators and arguments.
errors.formulaReference: A field or required linked entry is unavailable. Secrets cannot be referenced.
errors.formulaCycle: The formulas contain a dependency cycle.
errors.formulaArguments: Check the number of function arguments.
errors.formulaDate: The formula contains an invalid date.
errors.formulaBudget: The formula or its result is too large.
errors.dynamicFormulaIndex: This formula depends on NOW(): it can be displayed, but cannot be indexed, sorted, filtered or grouped.
errors.invalidQuickAction: This quick action is unavailable for the field or value.

stableFieldType: Existing field types are immutable. Create a new field to use another type.
deleted: Object deleted. Its data is retained.
independentLayouts: Each configuration is independent. Changing a card does not change the form or list.
csvImportHint: Import creates new records. The whole file is saved in one transaction after confirmation. Maximum size: 100 MB. The import delimiter is detected automatically. Relations use existing record UUIDs; backlink columns are skipped.
csvExportHint: Choose fields. Save through the system dialog; dates and booleans follow the selected locale.
csvPreviewCount: Validated rows: {{count}}. Showing the first ten.
exportFiltered: Apply current search and list filters
relationDefinitionUnavailable: The collection or source field is unavailable. Links are retained.
relationDerivedHint: Backlinks are computed after saving the record.
noMoveTargets: This library has no available collections. Choose another library.
moveTargetUnavailable: Could not load the move destination
inboxMoveHint: Choose a collection and complete its required fields. The entry stays in Inbox until you save.
quickFormHint: Choose fields for quick entry. Validation, required fields and defaults come from the regular form. Hidden required fields must have valid defaults.
draftSchemaChanged: Fields changed after this draft was saved. Review the values; unknown fields are retained.
staleFormChoice: The entry changed after you opened it. Load its current data instead of your input, or explicitly save your own revision.
profileCopyHint: Creates an independent copy of the current display settings. Records stay shared.
usePresetByDefault: Use for a short press on +
presetValuesHint: Prefills a new entry. There is no record until Save. A restored draft takes priority.
presetUnknownField: Unavailable field {{id}}. Its value is retained in the preset.
inboxMarkdownMapped: Title and body were mapped to the configured fields. The complete original will also be retained.
inboxMappingFallback: The configured mapping is unavailable. All text was placed in the incoming field; the original will also be retained.
csvCancelled: Operation cancelled. The database was not changed.
deviceAppearanceHint: Theme, density and text size are saved only on this device.
constructorCollectionHint: Configure fields, forms and display profiles. Check the result on records below.
constructorChooseHint: Select a library or collection to configure.
rowDesignerHint: Each row has 1, 2 or 3 columns. Fields stack on phones. Unassigned fields remain at the end; removing a row never deletes its fields.
emptyCollectionsHint: Create a collection and configure its fields.
libraryStartHint: Normal launch opens all libraries. This setting applies when opening a library; forms and unsaved input never open automatically.
libraryShortcutRequested: The shortcut request was sent. Confirm it in the system dialog if prompted.
libraryLaunchPending: The shortcut library will open after the current form is closed.
readUnavailableHint: The data could not be loaded. Please try again.
historyHint: The latest 20 explicitly saved versions, newest first. Viewing changes nothing.
restoreVersionHint: This explicitly saves the selected data and collection as current and creates a new version. Current field and relation rules apply.
clearHistoryHint: Current records remain. Cleared versions cannot be restored; synchronization propagates the clear to other devices.
clearAllHistoryHint: This clears the retained versions of every record in this database.
draftRecovered: The damaged draft has been preserved separately for recovery. You can continue creating a new record.
trashHint: Deleted records from every library and Inbox. Restore returns a record to its collection without creating a new version.
trashRetentionHint: Retention starts when a record is deleted. Saving this setting permanently deletes expired records and their history and attachments. Cleanup also runs on startup and while the app is active.
trashParentDeleted: Restore the library and collection before restoring this record.
purgeEntryHint: Permanently delete “{{title}}”, its entire history and attachments? This cannot be undone.
largeAttachmentHint: This file exceeds the shared threshold. You can export a separate copy.
attachmentOtherCopies_one: {{count}} other known copy on another device.
attachmentOtherCopies_few: {{count}} other known copies on other devices.
attachmentOtherCopies_many: {{count}} other known copies on other devices.
attachmentOtherCopies_other: {{count}} other known copies on other devices.
removeAttachmentCopyHint: Remove this file from this device? Its reference, metadata and history remain.
lastAttachmentCopyHint: This is the only known copy. Removing it may permanently lose the file bytes. Its reference, metadata and history remain.
attachmentLimitHint: Default: 10 MiB per file. Larger files are intended for separate transfer, with metadata in archives and synchronization. Individual copy export is available now.
attachmentCleanupHint: Some files have not yet been removed. Removal will retry when the app next opens, or you can retry now.
databaseWelcome: Create a new database or restore an archive. No internet required.
archiveUnencrypted: The archive is not encrypted. Anyone with the file can read its data, including Secret values. Store it securely.
archiveExportHint: Portable ZIP with data and history. Small attachments are included; large ones are metadata and placeholders. Keys, mail passwords and local queues are excluded. Creation drafts are excluded.
archiveImportHint: The archive is checked in isolated storage. Import replaces the database; it does not merge data. Replacement also removes local creation drafts; the archive does not contain them.
archiveReady: Data and file integrity verified. The archive is ready to restore.
archiveExportBeforeReplace: Export the current database above before replacing it. You may explicitly confirm replacement without exporting.
archiveReplaceConfirm: I confirm replacing the current database with this archive
secretPlaintextHint: Masking hides the screen value. The database and open ZIP are not encrypted. Secrets are excluded from search, general lists and drafts.
formulaSyntaxHint: Put fields in square brackets. Separate function arguments with commas and decimal places with a dot.
formulaDynamicHint: NOW() and its dependents refresh on display; sorting, filtering and grouping by these fields are unavailable.
quickActionsHint: Assigned actions update the entry immediately without a user history version. Formulas and related totals are refreshed.

dateSelection.label: Date filter
dateSelection.hint: Relative periods follow the device’s local date. Weeks start on Monday; record date ranges match by overlap.
dateSelection.noFields: Add a date, local date and time, or date range field.

queryTotalsHint: Computed across all matching records, including pages not yet loaded.
summaryEmptyHint: Add widgets in the library constructor.
summaryEditorHint: Widgets use records and collection profiles. No profile means an independent query without default filters.
summaryFormulaIdsHint: Use canonical English functions and field UUIDs, for example SUM([UUID]).
reminderFallback: No reminder app is available. Try Add to calendar.
calendarUnavailable: Could not open the external app; Tessera data is unchanged.
diagnosticsPrivacy: Only SQLite status and integrity are included; no records, secrets, paths, files or credentials.
largeAttachmentsHint: Files above the configured threshold. Export uses an explicit system dialog for each file.
